about_the_game:
SURVIVE THE COLD AGAIN AND AGAIN

Face hordes of intelligent enemies in a frozen world that constantly evolves.
Resist the growing cold, confront massive bosses, and survive long enough to reach the Convergence.
Each run is a new challenge where power, strategy, and survival are your only chances to escape the ice.

A HANDCRAFTED FROZEN WORLD

3 main zones, each with its own final boss and unique mechanics.
Handcrafted environments with strong identity, enhanced by random systems to ensure constant variety.
Every run is unique — abilities, upgrades, and items change each time you play.

A FAST AND STRATEGIC GAMEPLAY

Skills trigger automatically under precise rules, but your movement and aim remain essential.
Explore zones, collect the best upgrades, and plan your route to maximize survival and loot.
The longer you endure, the stronger the enemies — and the colder the world becomes.
At first, surviving more than 7 minutes per zone is an achievement, with average runs lasting around 30 minutes.

CHARACTER PROGRESSION AND BUILD CUSTOMIZATION

Defeat enemies to level up and gain powerful traits.
Open chests to obtain stackable items that persist through runs.
Take part in dynamic events:

  • Enemy waves to clear

  • Towers to destroy

  • Spirits to capture

  • Mini-bosses to defeat

  • Zones to conquer

  • Extraction pillars to destroy for rewards or use to escape

Every choice impacts your survival and your rewards.

A DEEP AND FLEXIBLE PROGRESSION

Upgrades go far beyond simple stat boosts:

  • Evolving stats with each level up

  • Rare traits that completely change your playstyle

  • Transformations, spirit summons, multi-casting, simultaneous elemental storms...
    The possibilities are nearly endless — each run can become a true explosion of power.

UNLOCK NEW CONTENT AS YOU PLAY

Each run grants you new unlockable content:

  • 3 playable classes (for now)

  • 55 skills to experiment with

  • 25 character traits for simple stat bonuses

  • 30 collectible items, reusable between runs

  • Over 250 upgrade traits for your skills and gameplay

Each run makes you stronger!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: 64-bit Windows Vista, Windows 8, Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: 2.3GHz or faster processor (Intel 2nd generation core i-series or equivalent)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Face waves of enemies in Cryoborn: Convergence, an action roguelite where each run brings you closer to divine power. Upgrade your abilities, survive the spreading cold, and defeat the final boss before the ice consumes you.
supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian
*languages with full audio support
